rows.text: Returns 0 when `rcx` is null; otherwise clears byte `+0x27`, takes the text at qword `+0x10` (else `+0`) and as limit the float of signed word `+0x24`, prepares a stack context with `002AC1E0` and `0039BAD0` (on `rdx`, or qword `+0x18` when `rdx` is null), copies dword `+0x28` and a context byte to `+0x10D0`/`+0x1104` of the record at `[0209CC40]`, measures the text with `002B2150` and copies `+0x10D0` back; when the truncated width is not above the truncated limit (signed `jg`), or when `00254A10` returns zero, it stores the text to `+8`, the returned length to word `+0x22`, the byte there to `+0x26`, the address after that byte (0 when it is zero) to `+0x10`, and to `+0x27` the value 2 when byte `+0x1104` is 0x26 else 0 (OR 1 in the `00254A10` case); otherwise it extends a prefix chunk by chunk (`002B1FB0` lengths), measuring each prefix with `002B2150` behind a temporary terminator, and when a prefix is above the limit (`comiss`/`ja`) sets bit `0x1` of `+0x27` and records the previous prefix the same way (with `+0x10` pointing at the break byte), or, when a chunk length is 0 or the text is null, zeroes `+8`, `+0x10`, `+0x22` and `+0x26`; it returns the value stored to `+0x10`.

corrections.why: byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: The record at `0209CC40` is not at that address: both copies (`002B5412`, `002B544E`) load the record pointer from the qword at `0209CC40` (`mov rcx, qword ptr [rip+...]`), so `+0x10D0`/`+0x1104` belong to the pointed-to record.
